variants.a-clinique:
Generate ONE cinematic photorealistic game environment concept image, landscape 16:9. This is a plausible playable first-person screen, not a poster or a collage. A vulnerable expressive humanoid robot sits restrained in a maintenance chair in a science-fiction treatment room. Its posture conveys exhaustion, not aggression. The robot is initially mostly intact; suggest mechanical body horror through cables and joints, not an already mutilated subject.
CAMERA: centered frontal composition, camera just above the seated robot's eyes, natural approximately 45mm equivalent perspective. Frame the robot from head to knees, large enough that its face, chest and both forearms are clearly readable. Keep all interaction targets sharp. No dramatic wide-angle distortion. The robot and chair dominate the composition; this is not a distant architectural establishing shot.
INTERACTION DESIGN: a large robust electrical socket on the chest; an open maintenance hatch on one forearm with a lodged metal fragment visibly distinct from a connected functional cable; a chunky rotary restraint lock on the opposite chair armrest. These three targets must be visually distinct, not tiny ornamental details. A narrow workbench edge in the foreground holds a compact electrical probe and a pair of extraction pliers without obscuring the robot. No human hands or extra characters. The chair and robot are physically believable with clear limb separation and coherent anatomy.
COMPOSITION: subdued uncluttered background, restrained material detail away from interaction targets, visually quiet bottom strip for later subtitles. Carefully lit legible subject, not an almost black horror image. Surface imperfections and tangible materials, not a glossy toy or cartoon.
OUTPUT: one image only, no text, labels, logos, watermark, UI, split panels or inset closeups. Do not bake in sparks, smoke or motion blur; this is the calm starting state before interaction.
ART DIRECTION: Cold industrial clinic. Worn ivory ceramic robot shell over dark steel joints, subtle black hydraulic fluid residue. Clean functional treatment room with pale panels and restrained industrial hardware. Cool white medical key light from upper camera-left, faint warm amber status lights. Uneasy contrast between clinical cleanliness and the robot's vulnerability. Realistic cinematic production design, precise readable shapes.
